newsitem.title: USA: Energen share offering priced at $29.50.
newsitem.headline: Energen share offering priced at $29.50.

text.p: Energen Corp said Friday its offering of 1.5 million shares was priced at $29.50 a share.

Proceeds will be used to repay some short-term debt incurred to fund the acquisition of oil and natural gas properties by its Taurus Exploration subsidiary in fiscal 1996, the company said in a statement.

Salomon Brothers Inc is the lead underwriter. Co-managers are Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and AG Edwards & Sons Inc. The underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to 225,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
After the offering, Energen will have about 12.8 million shares outstanding.
